# roccobot.github.io

> Projects by Rocco Casadei (Roccobot), graphic designer and photographer. Each project has its own repository, published by GitHub Pages at its own path of this domain.

## Sites

- [I Grandi di Arda](https://roccobot.github.io/arda/): a bilingual ranking of the mightiest beings in Tolkien's legendarium. Data guide: [llms.txt](https://roccobot.github.io/arda/llms.txt).
- [I Grandi di Terramare](https://roccobot.github.io/earthsea/): a bilingual ranking of the characters of Le Guin's Earthsea cycle. Data guide: [llms.txt](https://roccobot.github.io/earthsea/llms.txt).
- [AIV](https://roccobot.github.io/AIV/): download page of Astonishing Image Viewer, an image viewer and editor for Android.
- [CleanSVG](https://roccobot.github.io/CleanSVG/): a page that cleans up SVG files.
- [RatioLab](https://roccobot.github.io/ratiolab/): a page about ratios between two numbers.
- [Ma che parola è](https://roccobot.github.io/cheparolae/): a page of Italian words in a column.
- [Aomidori](https://roccobot.github.io/Aomidori/): download page of Aomidori, a minimal EPUB and comic (CBZ, CBR) reader for macOS.
